description: 4 AG Robotics is revolutionizing mushroom farming with its fully autonomous harvesting platform. Where traditional mushroom harvesting is labor-intensive, costly, and delicate, 4AG delivers an AI-driven, real-time robotic solution that integrates seamlessly into existing infrastructure, harvesting, trimming, and packing mushrooms around the clock with precision and consistency. The platform is built for scale and sustainability. Designed for plug-and-play deployment into standard Dutch-rack systems, 4AG’s robots eliminate labor bottlenecks and deliver operational data in real time. This capability ensures farms can ramp up output without reconfiguring their facilities. Rooted in local expertise, thriving globally. Based in Salmon Arm, BC, 4AG leverages regional engineering and manufacturing partnerships to build and refine its robotic systems, all while maintaining a strong connection to its Canadian roots
tagline: Automating mushroom trimming, picking and packing

description: A ardaia is a Wageningen-based startup that invents new crops rather than re-engineering the ones the world already farms. Today we draw around 95% of our calories from roughly 30 plant species, out of more than 400,000 on Earth, a narrow base that leaves our food system exposed to climate stress and supply shocks. Aardaia widens it by identifying wild plants that already carry valuable traits, such as drought tolerance or the ability to fix their own nitrogen, and breeding them into viable crops, with no genetic modification or gene editing. Its first crop is the aardaker, a protein-rich, nitrogen-fixing tuber that needs no synthetic fertiliser and could one day grow up to five times more protein per hectare than any crop farmed today. By building large genomic datasets and predicting which plants will perform before a seed goes in the ground, Aardaia compresses what once took centuries of breeding into a matter of years. Founded in 2025 by Pádraic Flood and Mike Henske, the company is building a more diverse and resilient supply of protein, one new crop at a time.
tagline: Breeding forgotten plants into protein-rich crops

description: A griculture depends on crop protection, yet most of what farmers spray never reaches the plant. Droplets bounce off leaves and run into the soil and waterways, so growers apply far more chemistry than their crops actually absorb, driving up costs, emissions and environmental load. The industry has lacked any way to measure, in the moment, how much spray truly lands on the leaf. AgZen, spun out of MIT, gives farmers real-time feedback on their spraying. Its RealCoverage system uses cameras mounted on any sprayer to measure, while the machine is moving, how much product reaches each leaf, and adjusts application on the fly. Its EnhanceCoverage nozzle technology helps droplets stick rather than bounce. In field trials the approach has cut pesticide use by up to half while maintaining or improving yields, and AgZen has passed one million commercial acres in the US with commitments extending across Australia and Argentina. By putting precise, measurable control over crop inputs directly in farmers’ hands, AgZen lowers the chemical and carbon load of agriculture without asking growers to sacrifice productivity. It reflects Astanor’s conviction that resilient food systems are built by using less to grow more.
tagline: Precise crop spraying that halves pesticide use

description: A kson Robotics is a Danish agritech startup that specializes in integrating artificial intelligence, robotics, drones, and machine learning into real-world agricultural applications. Their goal is to make farming more efficient, profitable, and environmentally friendly by using AI to enable precision farming . A core product of theirs is CropUp , a SaaS platform that allows farmers, agronomists, or pilots to upload aerial (drone) images of their fields, where AI models detect and distinguish between weeds and crops at a very fine level. From those detections, “spraymaps” can be generated that show exactly where one should apply herbicides, rather than spraying an entire field uniformly. This saves costs, lowers chemical use, helps yield, and reduces environmental impact.
tagline: Leveraging AI-powered drones to enable precision agriculture

description: A t Amplifye, they are discovering and developing proprietary ingredients to amplify the power of protein nutrition in foods and dietary supplements. Their foundational technology is a class of enzyme ingredients capable of unlocking the full nutritional value of protein-based foods and dietary supplements. Amplifye is a pioneering, best-in-class food biotech company dedicated to transforming protein nutrition and global health. They combine a passion for enabling better human health and performance with a game-changing technology discovered at the University of California, Davis.
tagline: Unlocking the full health potential of proteins, accessible to all

description: F ood waste typifies the paradoxes of our global food system, where an estimated 40% of the food grown globally is never consumed, due to supply chain inefficiencies and consumer waste, while nearly 30% of the world’s population remains malnourished and food insecure (Source: FAO). Food loss between harvest and consumption also exacerbates the climate crisis, through wasted inputs (land, water, energy, fertilizers, pesticides), energy spent fueling a supply chain that fails to deliver nutrition, and greenhouse gases emitted from wasted food itself. Apeel was established to address these issues using plant-based solutions. Apeel developed and produces plant-based coatings for fresh produce that act as a “second peel” to minimize water and gas transfer. This technology allows produce to preserve its freshness and nutrition, fight spoilage, maintain taste and texture, and extend shelf life by two times or more that of untreated produce. These coatings are applied via Apeel’s machinery, which integrates into the supply chain. The produce is also branded with Apeel’s logo, to indicate to consumers that the fruits and vegetables they buy are fresher and longer lasting. Apeel’s technology brings system-wide impact. As Apeel’s product is integrated across the food system, fewer resources are wasted producing uneaten food, less plastic is required for food packaging, less fuel is expended in rapid shipping, less energy is wasted on in-store refrigeration, fewer GHGs are emitted from wasted food in landfills, and more people of all income levels have access to fresh fruit and vegetables in all parts of the world.
tagline: Plant-based protection for longer-lasting produce

description: A phea.Bio is an innovative biotechnology company dedicated to advancing sustainable agriculture through the development of biological solutions. Aphea.Bio focuses on high-quality, science-based products comprising novel, natural microorganisms to enhance plant health, improve crop yields, and promote soil fertility. By leveraging cutting-edge research and development, Aphea.Bio creates effective biostimulants and biocontrol products that reduce dependence on mineral fertilizers and chemical pesticides, which are harmful for the environment. The APEXbio™ platform, which combines unique know-how and disruptive technologies in research and product development accelerates product development by harnessing the diversity of microorganisms. Through its APEXbio™ platform, Aphea.Bio has developed a rich pipeline of candidate products in all important product segments: biostimulants, biofungicides, bioinsecticides and bioherbicides – underpinned by a broad and high value patent portfolio. Aphea.Bio’s biostimulant products ACTIV by Aphea.Bio™ and INITIA by Aphea.Bio™ improve nutrient use efficiency and yield in wheat and maize respectively. They stimulate root growth and vigor, enhance water uptake, and bolster soil health. VIRTUOSA™ is a novel, patented foliar biofungicide for fruits and vegetable crops, designed to provide broad-spectrum protection against major fungal diseases. Aphea.Bio is a Certified B Corporation, reflecting the commitment to meet high social and environmental impact, accountability and transparency.
tagline: Next-generation agro-biologicals for a sustainable future

description: A t BettaF!sh, their priority is conserving the oceans. They are achieving that by building a whole new industry of impact-enhanced foods based on seaweed. Their fish alternatives taste and look just like the original but are 100% plant-based. Seaweed cultivation itself is regenerative and a sustainable alternative to fishing. This means people can continue to enjoy their favorite “seafood” guilt-free. They are co-funded by the European Union as part of EIT Food’s Rising Food Stars program. BettaF!sh is bringing the super ingredient seaweed to the forefront. Bursting with great taste, nutritional value, and environmental impact, it’s the hero of their TU-NAH and offers coastal communities new, more sustainable income opportunities. It’s time to taste the ocean!
tagline: Helping the oceans recover with a unique, plant-based tuna alternative

description: W orld’s first 100% plant-based alternative to fur, shearling, and plush. BioFluff is a biomaterials startup, focusing solely on reimagining fluffy materials. They have created the world’s first completely plant-based alternative to fur, shearling, and plush. They have two main product lines: Savian – Their Natural Fiber Material Brand Savian was launched at COP28 in collaboration with Stella McCartney as part of her pre-fall 2024 collection, introducing Savian Plant-based Fur. BioPlush – Their plant-based plush materials for children’s toys. They are currently further developing these materials. BioFluff is based in Paris and New York. They produce their materials in Europe.
tagline: Revolutionising the textile industry by pioneering a new era of plant-based alternatives to animal and synthetic derived materials

description: H eadquartered in Vilnius, Lithuania, Biomatter designs custom enzymes for industry. Enzymes drive chemical reactions in everything from detergents and food ingredients to animal feed and pharmaceutical manufacturing. But nature only evolved a tiny fraction of the enzymes that could exist, and rarely for the exact conditions of an industrial process. Improving a natural enzyme the traditional way can take years and often still falls short. Biomatter starts from the chemistry instead. It uses AI and physics-based modelling to design enzymes from scratch for a customer’s specific reaction and production conditions, then tests every design in its own lab. Customers receive a finished, working enzyme in weeks.
tagline: AI-designed enzymes for industrial processes, delivered in weeks

description: S ince 2022, Calice has been revolutionizing agriculture through advanced AI and computational data modeling. Our interdisciplinary team of scientists, engineers, and tech entrepreneurs, with over 15 years of combined experience, is dedicated to developing groundbreaking technologies that reshape ag-based companies. By leveraging on NODES – our propietary Computational Field Trials Platform, we take ag-based companies to the next level by helping them avoid investing millions of dollars and spend dozens of years in inefficient and uncertain field trials with AI-powered technology.
tagline: Empowering Agriculture with Computational Modeling

description: C alyxia has developed, through 25 years of fundamental research in colloid science, a unique technology to produce the world’s first readily biodegradable and advanced performance microcapsules, to directly combat global microplastic pollution. Through decades of pollution, there are now over 200 million tonnes of microplastics in our oceans and rivers. Microplastics are found in over 210 commercially important species of fish, in over 90% of all tap and bottled water worldwide. Today, microplastics are intentionally added to agriculture products to enhance crop yield, and to everyday products such as laundry detergents and shampoos, to provide long-lasting fragrance sensations. In addition, microplastics are generated by the deterioration of plastic materials used in automotive, electronics and sporting goods. In agriculture and everyday products, Calyxia microcapsules offers a biodegradable and resource efficient solution to replace and eliminate intentionally added microplastics. In advanced materials, Calyxia microcapsules provide a game-changing solution for manufacturers to create lighter, stronger and more durable materials. They prevent plastic materials from breaking down, by increasing the wear resistance and prolonging the product lifespan in-use by over 10 times. Calyxia partners with world-leading manufacturers in agriculture, home care and advanced materials to take on the war on microplastics and build a green and advanced future for all.
tagline: Ending global microplastic pollution with the power of green chemistry

description: F ounded in 2025 and based in London, Consensus Foods is building an AI decision layer for food manufacturing. Most food plants run on a patchwork of systems for planning, production, inventory and quality that were built for record-keeping, not real-time decisions. Choices about scheduling, formulation and purchasing are made in silos, which leads to lower yields, avoidable waste and idle production lines in an industry where margins are already tight. The platform connects to a manufacturer’s existing systems without replacing them and uses optimization and machine learning to improve production decisions across the plant. It starts with yield and line scheduling, then expands into procurement, supply chain and food safety, learning from actual production outcomes as it goes.
tagline: Optimizing food manufacturing with AI-driven decision-making

description: C rowdFarming – a solution for farming created by farmers Unlike many ideas of our time, CrowdFarming didn’t come about by typing code in a garage but by growing oranges on a farm. While trying to make a living as young farmers, they learned that they had to sell directly to end-consumers in order to succeed. In 2017, Gabriel and Gonzalo Úrculo joined forces with Juliette Simonin and Moisés Calviño to found crowdfarming.com and share their sales channel with other farmers. Since then, they’ve been working to remove intermediaries from the food supply chain. How do they remove intermediaries from a chain without becoming one themselves? The answer is simple: by providing value-added services. The direct sale of food between farmers and consumers requires certain services for it to take place: a platform to offer and sell products on, logistics to transport packages, customer service (for their “CrowdFarmers,” as they call them), and advertising tools to help farmers make themselves known. These are the four services CrowdFarming provides to farmers.
tagline: Ultra fresh, trusted and high-quality food, from farm-to-fork

description: C ulinary Sciences, Inc. (CSI) brings a revolutionary technology that transforms the High-Volume Food Preparation industry, an industry that has not seen any fundamental technology advancements since the introduction of the Microwave Oven…and that was in the 70’s. The CSI solution is called “EV” (Extreme Vacuum) and has 3 core value propositions. -Rapid Chilling – CSI’s Rapid-Chill™ cools food up to 5x faster using 80% less energy than current methods. This improves food safety, reduces waste, enhances quality, and delivers major sustainability benefits—like chilling 300 lbs. of chicken from 160°F to 40°F in just 20 minutes. -Accelerated Food Treatment – EVC technology speeds up processes like brining and marinating from days to hours, while infusing deeper flavor into both protein- and plant-based foods—enabling new product innovation and better taste. -Connected Kitchen Platform – CSI’s system serves as a digital backbone for kitchen operations. Through their “Kitchen Connect” network, they provide tools for remote diagnostics, productivity tracking, recipe control, food safety reporting, and more—streamlining operations with smart automation.
tagline: Bringing a revolutionary technology that transforms the High-Volume Food Preparation industry

description: B ased in Boston, Florey Biosciences engineers probiotics that deliver functional proteins directly in the gut. Antibiotics and modern diets can disrupt the gut microbiome, and that damage is linked to infections, antibiotic resistance and metabolic disease. Today’s probiotics rarely have a clear mechanism of action, and more advanced options like microbiome transplants are hard to make safely at scale. Florey’s platform gives probiotics a specific, controlled job in the gut. Its first product protects the microbiome during antibiotic treatment by neutralizing leftover antibiotic in the gut, while the drug keeps working in the body. Founded in 2024 by scientists from Harvard and the Wyss Institute, the company is developing its products as medical and functional foods.
tagline: Engineered probiotics for gut and metabolic health

description: G alley is the creator of the culinary resource planning category and a pioneer in foodservice technology. Galley is committed to revolutionizing culinary operations through data-driven insights and innovative solutions. Galley represents the beginning of a new era in the foodservice industry. They can now create an environment in which culinary precision is effortless, operational chaos becomes order, and every meal is crafted with the efficiency and artistry that customers crave and the kitchen aspires to. With over 150 years of collective experience in food service operations, farming, and hospitality management, their team has crafted every feature of Galley to solve the specific needs of modern food operations. Their commitment is to empower culinary teams with precise tools and insights, fostering innovation, streamlining operations, and ultimately improving the dining experience for customers worldwide.
tagline: The next-generation culinary‍ operating system

description: H eali gives you access to personalized, therapeutic nutrition plans recommended by registered dietitians, tailored to your tastes, needs and conditions. Whether you’ve got a food sensitivity, intolerance, health goal or medical condition, Heali helps you find what’s right to eat for your unique body.
tagline: Empowering everyone to enjoy food as medicine

description: U lisse BioMed is a healthcare biotech company operating in diagnostics, theranostics and therapeutics with the mission to develop innovative solutions in these fields. Ulisse BioMed has three proprietary technology platforms capable of generating innovative and competitive products: Sagitta (molecular diagnostics), NanoHybrid (theranostics and diagnostics) and Aptavir (therapeutics). Ulisse BioMed owns a portfolio of intellectual properties made of 8 international patent applications that cover the three technology platforms (3 related to Sagitta, 2 related to NanoHybrid, 1 related to Aptavir and 2 transversal to the three platforms), two of them are granted in Italy and in Europe.
tagline: Developing innovative and revolutionary diagnostic platforms and products

description: H eadquartered in London and founded in 2024, Hijack Bio is building a new way to deliver peptide drugs. Peptides like insulin and GLP-1 are among the most important medicines today, but they break down quickly in the stomach and gut, so most of them have to be injected. They are also expensive to make, need cold storage and are hard to get to patients in many parts of the world. The company engineers naturally beneficial gut bacteria to produce and release therapeutic peptides inside the body. Patients would take a daily capsule, and the bacteria would deliver the peptide from the gut into the bloodstream, removing the need for injections.
tagline: Engineering gut bacteria to deliver peptide drugs orally

description: T he gut microbes may hold the key to overcoming some of modern medicine's most urgent challenges. Holobiome was founded by research scientists from Northeastern University with the singular mission of translating the emerging science of the human microbiome into the next generation of probiotics and targeted solutions for whole-body health.
tagline: Developing first-in-class therapies from the human microbiome

description: H owGood is a SaaS data platform with the world’s largest database on food and personal care product sustainability. With more than 33,000 ingredients, chemicals and materials assessed, HowGood helps leading suppliers, brands and retailers understand and improve their environmental and social impact, through a global and detailed understanding of the impacts of their products. Drawing from over a decade of research mapping the global supply system for a wide range of industries including food and cosmetics, HowGood´s solution addresses the growing demand for product sustainability and transparency across the value chain. HowGood’s data set, which is consistently updated with the most recent findings from across over 500 sources, provides all-encompassing insights cover GHG emissions, water usage, labor risks, animal welfare, biodiversity, land use or soil health, among many others.These insights allow clients to improve purchasing decisions by measuring, comparing and analyzing the impact of both individual products and the aggregate impact across their portfolio of products. With HowGood’s solution, their clients become equipped to favor products with stronger positive or regenerative impacts across a portfolio of options.
tagline: The world’s largest sustainability intelligence database

description: H UNGRY is a national platform for top local chefs and food delivery services. They began as a tech-enabled platform for office and event catering, connecting clients to incredible chef entrepreneurs. Since then, they have rapidly grown into a national platform for top chef-made food production and delivery services. Their offerings now include business and event catering, contracted meal delivery services, chef-centric pop-ups, virtual chef experiences, and home meal delivery. HUNGRY is a purpose-driven company, dedicated to improving the lives of everyone they touch—the Chefs who are their partners, the Clients they serve, the Communities where they operate, and their amazing Team members. They live by 9 Core Values that guide everything they do, and they are committed to making a difference.
tagline: Corporate Catering from Top Local Chefs & Restaurants

description: I N TRUTH is a global pioneer in emotion intelligence, turning the passive data from everyday wearables into a real-time, objective measure of a person’s emotional and nervous-system state. Headquartered in San Francisco, the company has built the first objective measure of emotional regulation, its proprietary Emotion Score, translating beat-to-beat heart-rate data from devices people already own into an insight that was previously impossible to capture.
tagline: Turns passive data from everyday wearables into a real-time measure of emotional state

description: I UNU (pronounced “you-knew”) is redefining greenhouse agriculture through its AI-powered platform, LUNA AI . By integrating autonomous imaging systems with advanced analytics, LUNA AI provides growers with real-time, plant-level insights, enabling precise crop management and operational efficiency. We put the plant at the center and drive measurable benefits with our customers through Precision Yield Forecasting , an Automated Labor Quality Manager , and Dynamic Crop Steering . These tools deliver compartment-level insights to optimize plant health, balance, and quality throughout the season. Utilizing rail-mounted and trolley-based camera systems, LUNA AI captures high-resolution imagery of each plant and translates it into actionable data. This enables growers to scale production without scaling labor , increase yields, reduce waste, and make more confident decisions rooted in data. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Seattle, IUNU operates across North America and Europe, serving over 100 facilities in 18 countries.
tagline: Optimizing indoor farming with AI & computer vision

description: L a Fourche is transforming access to organic products in France through its innovative membership-based online grocery platform. Traditional organic shopping is expensive, fragmented, and often inconvenient, limiting adoption. La Fourche addresses these challenges by offering members over 4,500 carefully curated organic products at prices up to 50% below traditional retail, making healthy, sustainable living widely accessible. The platform spans groceries, beverages, personal care, household essentials, baby products, and bulk and anti-waste solutions. La Fourche prioritizes transparency, quality, and environmental responsibility: all products are free from pesticides, GMOs, palm oil, and harmful additives wherever possible. By partnering with local producers and fair-trade suppliers, it supports equitable supply chains and drives meaningful social and environmental impact. La Fourche’s model combines convenience, affordability, and sustainability into a single seamless experience. Members gain consistent pricing, easy access to diverse product categories, and the ability to make environmentally conscious choices without compromise. By lowering financial and logistical barriers, La Fourche empowers consumers to embrace a more sustainable lifestyle at scale. Led by a mission-driven founding team with deep expertise in retail, e-commerce, and sustainability, La Fourche demonstrates how technology and innovative business design can revolutionize a traditional industry. Its approach not only expands access to organic products but also sets a new standard for responsible consumption, driving measurable impact across health, society, and the environment. La Fourche represents a breakthrough in sustainable retail, turning affordability, accessibility, and impact into a scalable business model—and a compelling investment opportunity at the intersection of consumer health, environmental stewardship, and digital innovation.
tagline: Providing access to affordable organic food

description: LiveCycle is transforming how companies understand and manage their environmental impact through its intelligent LCA platform. Traditional life cycle assessments are slow, expensive, and quickly become outdated. LiveCycle changes that by delivering advanced, certifiable LCA results in a fraction of the time, with continuous updates so companies always possess “live” LCA data across their whole product portfolio. This flexible and data-driven approach makes LiveCycle uniquely positioned to meet the growing demand for credible sustainability insights across complex supply chains. By combining automation with complete transparency, the platform gives teams full control over their data. There are no black boxes and no compromises. LiveCycle’s always-on monitoring keeps assessments accurate and relevant. Updates and alerts are triggered by changes in supplier inputs, internal processes, or external data. This results in full SKU-level coverage and turns LCAs into a strategic asset that supports companies in their decision-making and substantiating their sustainability claims to the market. The company is led by a mission-driven founding team with deep expertise in software, sustainability, and operations. Their experience helps companies turn regulatory pressure and ESG expectations into lasting competitive advantages. LiveCycle’s technology represents a breakthrough in the shift toward truly data-driven sustainability, bringing transparency and environmental intelligence to the core of business strategy.
tagline: LCA Intelligence without compromising on credibility

description: The EU ‘Farm to Fork Strategy’ requires a reduction in pesticide use by 50% by 2030. Some countries have added their own additional laws to support similar ends. This is welcome news for healthy soil and ecosystems across Europe – and a tremendous adaptation challenge for the agriculture sector. Agricultural practices and technical solutions that reduce the use of pesticides are in demand now, out of necessity, and will be paramount in achieving EU targets. M agGrow is an enabler for countries to reach these ambitious targets. It’s patented, proprietary technology significantly reduces waste associated with conventional pesticide spray applications, delivering important plant protection products where they matter the most. The MagGrow technology passes pesticides through magnetic fields under appropriate flow conditions and changes the physical properties of the fluid. This delivers both superior spray drift control and crop coverage. Increased spray coverage performance can range from 20% to well over 100% compared to conventional spraying. MagGrow has many other benefits, such as a significant reduction in water usage by up to 50%, extended spray windows, and reductions in labour. The MagGrow system has no moving parts, is easy to install and maintain, and can be fitted to a new or existing crop sprayer. Farmers who are using MagGrow’s technology to date are spending typically >€100k on spraying per annum.
tagline: Grow more by using less, reduced pesticide use with improved spray technology

description: M atrix Pack is a global leader in sustainable packaging solutions, replacing single-use plastics with high-performance paper and fiber-based alternatives. Headquartered in Greece, the company designs and manufactures biodegradable and compostable products such as straws, trays, cups, cutlery, and capsules combining proprietary fiber blends, robotics, and advanced machinery to match the functionality of plastic without the environmental footprint. With state-of-the-art facilities in Greece, the UK, Bulgaria, the U.S., and Thailand, and 10 distribution centers serving over 60 countries, Matrix Pack supplies leading brands across quick-service restaurants, retail, FMCG, and food service. Leveraging expertise in both wet and dry fiber processes, the company is among the few globally able to scale multiple molded-fiber applications pioneering the next generation of circular, renewable packaging.
tagline: Matrix Pack manufactures sustainable, fiber-based packaging for the global food and beverage sector.

description: T oo many passionate and talented women who dream of becoming chefs still face numerous obstacles today. The three founders—Donia, Loubna, and Youssef—created Meet My Mama with a clear mission: to showcase the culinary talent of “Mamas” from around the world, helping them turn their passion into a livelihood and, in doing so, build a more inclusive, sustainable, and responsible society.
tagline: Supporting immigrant & refugee women building food service businesses

description: M etabolic Psychiatry Labs treats serious mental illness through metabolism. People with conditions like bipolar disorder, major depression and schizophrenia often also struggle with obesity, insulin resistance and other metabolic problems, and each condition makes the other worse. Standard care treats the two separately, and psychiatric medication alone often has limited effect. The company runs a remote care program that combines psychiatric treatment with personalized metabolic interventions: diet, including ketogenic approaches, supplements and medication adjustments. Patients are monitored through an app that tracks lab results, glucose and ketone levels and mental health measures, and the data guides each person’s treatment. The company was founded by Dr. Shebani Sethi, who pioneered the field of metabolic psychiatry at Stanford, and is based in Menlo Park, California.
tagline: Mental health vare, with metabolic therapy, from your home

description: H eadquartered in San Francisco, Metabolize is building a new category of precision metabolite products for weight management. GLP-1 drugs have changed how people lose weight, but most patients stop treatment at some point because of cost, side effects or access, and most of the weight comes back. There is no clear standard of care for this phase, and as GLP-1 use keeps growing, more people are reaching it every year. The company’s first product, NatLean, is a dietary supplement designed to help people keep the weight off after stopping GLP-1 therapy. It is based on metabolites the body already produces, which regulate appetite and metabolism through pathways different from GLP-1.
tagline: Weight management post-GLP-1 discontinuation

description: M icroHarvest’s proprietary technology enables the production of protein using bacteria at a speed and efficiency that greatly exceeds existing approaches. MicroHarvest’s production speed is unparalleled: raw materials can be turned into final protein products within a single day (compared to months for plant-based or animal protein). Being able to ramp up production quickly is key to becoming a relevant player in the B2B ingredients market. It enables decentralized production of sustainable, nutritious, high-quality and safe protein. Their ‘elegantly simple’ fermentation technology approach can be scaled in a decentralized way to produce single-cell proteins for different use cases varying from pet and human food to animal feed. MicroHarvest is led by highly complementary founders. CEO Kate Bekers combines both biotech expertise and business development acumen, CTO Luisa Cruz spent her entire academic and professional career in bioprocessing and COO Jonathan Roberz has been successful as an entrepreneur since graduating high school. At scale, MicroHarvest products can become a significant contributor to the urgently needed transition towards sustainable, affordable proteins. In addition, the decentralized production empowers the development towards more food independence and supply chain resilience.
tagline: A resilient food system, using the power of microorganisms

description: M iiMOSA is the leading funding marketplace dedicated to agricultural, energy and food transition. The platform connects donors and lenders with farmers in search of financing. Through the platform, individuals, corporate partners and investment funds can find investment opportunities that are both financially attractive and more impactful than traditional asset classes. Borrowers obtain tailor-made solutions adapted to their financing needs, whether that be evolving their production methods, diversifying their business to include other commercial activities associated with the farm, managing inter-generational transition, or otherwise. Agricultural financing needs have more than doubled in the last ten years, yet solutions haven’t evolved or adapted to support sector-specific challenges. This is critical as these challenges are at the heart of what’s blocking more sustainable practices from becoming mainstream and a more resilient agriculture sector from emerging. The existing banking system lacks responsiveness to do this. However, interest among individual investors and consumers to contribute to a more sustainable planet and invest in highly impactful companies, especially in food and agriculture, has grown substantially – presenting an opportunity to connect mission-aligned capital and demand.
tagline: Financing the transition to regenerative agriculture

description: M i Terro creates sustainable and durable bio-based materials for paper packaging coatings, home care products, food packaging, textiles, and more. They envision biomaterials that can be returned to nature after use, leaving no harm to the environment. Their biomaterials are home compostable, marine degradable, hydrophilic or hydrophobic, and 10–40% cheaper than other bio-based alternatives. Additionally, their materials are compatible with existing plastic processing equipment.
tagline: Turning agricultural waste into compostable biomaterials to replace single-use plastic

description: M odern Meadow is harnessing nature’s building blocks to achieve new material functionality and properties for the way we want the future to perform. As a pioneer of biofabrication, Modern Meadow develops novel materials that have enhanced sustainability and performance profiles that can be applied across multiple industries such as textiles and beauty. Modern Meadow’s strength lies at the intersection of biology and material science, and the ability to integrate innovative material solutions and processes together. Fossil-fuel derived energy production and use accounts for approximately 2/3 of our global manmade greenhouse gas emissions, while direct livestock emissions account for another 14.5% (Source: World Resources Institute and Food & Agriculture Organization). Modern Meadow was established to lead the way to a new bioeconomy and shift our dependence away from petroleum- and animal-based material inputs. Modern Meadow’s biofabrication technology brings real impact: developing bio-based solutions that address performance, sustainability, and accessibility. To tackle this challenge, Modern Meadow is creating a coalition of trusted industry partners and brand collaborators committed to climate responsible choices. Together, we will launch the next generation of biofabricated material solutions.
tagline: Pioneering biofabrication to achieve new material functionality

description: T he Monarch Tractor combines electrification, automation, machine learning and data analysis to set a new standard in tractor technology capabilities. Monarch is a mission-driven company aiming to elevate farming practices to enable clean, efficient and economically viable solutions for farmers. They are leveraging technology more commonly associated with battery-powered automotive players such as Tesla to build robotic tractors. Monarch operates much like a software company. The world class team assembled is iterating and deploying rapidly. Monarch is in relentless pursuit of building not just the best electric tractor, but the best tractor. Cutting emissions: Unlike your standard diesel tractor, which produces roughly 14 times the emissions of the average car, the Monarch Tractor is 100% electric, has zero tailpipe emissions and is just as powerful with 40-70 horsepower. This cuts over 60% of the farm’s fuel and service expenses while also significantly reducing the farm’s contribution to climate change. Monarch tractors, when charged with renewable electricity, reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 53 tons per year. Driver-optional: In addition, the Monarch Tractor is driver-optional, allowing operators to simultaneously pilot multiple tractors while allowing farmers to ride the vehicle like a conventional tractor. Unlocking Data: Cameras on the sides of the tractor feed a continuous stream of images that inform decisions on where and when to plant. These critical data points can be used for real-time implementation adjustments, as well as long-term yield estimates.
tagline: Accelerating Regenerative Agriculture

description: S ingle-use plastics are destroying our ocean and land ecosystems, with 8 million metric tons of plastic added to the ocean every year (Source: NOAA). At the same time, more microplastics are being absorbed into the food chain with harmful health outcomes. Plastic is also very carbon intensive to produce, emitting GHGs at every step in the production and consumption cycle, from cradle to grave. It’s time to move away from plastic and particularly single-use plastics, in our food system and beyond. The challenge to-date has been the performance, in functionality and price, of alternatives, and supportive regulatory frameworks to incentivise transition. Europe had been a leader in supporting this transition. With its team of material scientists, mechanical engineers and designers, Notpla has created a seaweed-based packaging material which can replace single-use plastics in a variety of formats. Created from brown seaweed, the material is biodegradable, renewable, microplastics-free and even edible. Brown seaweed itself can grow up to 1m per day, does not compete with food crops for resources, does not rely on fresh water or fertilizer to grow, actively contributes to de-acidifying the oceans and naturally captures CO2. Notpla’s material is highly functional and can be used for sauce sachets, liners for disposable takeaway food boxes, and films to replace flexible plastic bags. The company develops both the materials and the machinery to manufacture these items at scale. With the positive impacts generated during both the production and disposal of its products, Notpla aligns with Astanor’s vision for unpolluted, naturally sustainable ocean ecosystems.
tagline: Making plastic packaging disappear

description: P esticide resistance and declining pollinators jeopardize the 75% of agricultural crops reliant on pollination, slashing yields, increasing waste, and driving up carbon footprints. Aphid infestations alone can cause crop losses of up to 80%, further straining production. Enclosed growing environments add to the challenge by being inhospitable to traditional pollinators. Olombria’s cutting-edge AI-powered Integrated Pest and Pollinator Management (IPPM) system delivers precise interventions and actionable insights, empowering growers to maximize yields and sustainability.
tagline: AI-powered bio-pest control and pollinator management system

description: C hronic wounds are one of the most costly and least visible burdens in modern healthcare. Conditions such as diabetic foot ulcers, venous leg ulcers and pressure ulcers affect millions of people worldwide, and many are rooted in metabolic disease, poor circulation and diet. They heal slowly, are painful to manage, and conventional care is often fragmented across multiple products, dressings and clinic visits. When a wound fails to close, the consequences escalate quickly, from chronic infection to, in the worst cases, amputation. Yet innovation in wound care has been slow, and most treatments manage the wound rather than actively driving it to heal. Omeza is a regenerative skin and wound care company built around the healing power of omega-3 fatty acids. Its lead product, the Omeza Collagen Matrix, combines hydrolysed fish collagen with cod liver oil and plant-derived oils to protect the wound bed and support tissue regeneration, working alongside the Omeza Lidocaine Lavage and Omeza Skin Protectant. Together they simplify the episode of care and help wounds close faster, at any site of care from hospital to home. The natural formulation delivers omega 3, 6 and 9 fatty acids, tissue-signalling molecules and vitamins A, C, D and E, all drawn from marine and plant sources. The product bundle was recognised with a Top Innovation in Wound Care award by Wound Management & Prevention. By using marine and plant-derived nutrition to heal wounds that conventional medicine struggles with, Omeza sits precisely where food and human health meet. Its work reflects Astanor’s conviction that what nature produces, from soil and sea, can help prevent and reverse the chronic conditions that weigh most heavily on human health.
tagline: Healing chronic wounds with omega-3 nutrition

description: P lanetary is enabling the scaling of the protein revolution by providing fermentation capabilities for the future. Their technology is laser-focused on scaling global upstream and downstream fermentation capacity to unlock the potential of alternative protein products. Because fermentation-based alternate protein production is today still a young industry with many companies in early phases of R&D, Planetary is building the bioreactor capacity to help these companies scale rapidly. Within the food space alone, fermentation tech promises to deliver sustainable and functional replacements for meats, milk, cheese, eggs and more. Fermentation technology is hailed as the holy grail of alternative protein, but today only 5% of the total global fermentation capacity is designed for food products, with most of it being already contracted for the foreseeable future. It is predicted that by 2030, between 10% and 20% of all meat, dairy, eggs and seafood consumed will be of alternative origin, but in order to make these projections a reality, bioprocessing capacity needs to be built, scaled, and made available at an affordable price globally. Led by experts in bioprocessing, engineering, product formulations and food economics, Planetary’s technology is essential to creating the alternative protein products that can meet consumer demand for taste and nutrition, overcoming the current unmet needs.
tagline: Building the bioreactor capacity the food industry needs

description: P lantible is on a mission to revolutionize the food industry by harnessing the power of the humble, awe-inspiring Lemna to create the world’s most functional and applicable plant-based protein. Founded in 2018 by Tony Martens and Maurits van de Ven with the goal of reshaping the world’s food supply chain, Plantible has developed a vertically integrated agricultural platform to produce Rubi Protein™ from Lemna, more commonly known as duckweed. Rubi Protein is a natural, plant-based protein that emulates the functional characteristics of widely used animal-based proteins and enables food companies to match the taste and texture of animal-based products with more sustainable plant-based ingredients. Already cost-competitive with regular eggs, this protein allows customers to replace eggs without compromising on taste, texture and functionality and meet the growing consumer demand for sustainable, nutritious, animal-free products. The diversification of plant-based protein sources is fundamental to ensuring the security of the global food system for generations to come. Most plant-based proteins available today are derived from a select few crops that have annual crop cycles and are therefore prone to climate change. Lemna doubles in mass every 48 hours, enabling a consistent daily harvest throughout the year and is considered to be one of the most protein-efficient crops in the world, yielding 10x more protein per acre than soy, while requiring 10x less water.
tagline: Plant-based nutrition for all humanity

description: P roducePay is a US Based Ag-tech/Fin-tech startup that lets farmers focus on farming by making all other elements of the industry predictable, transparent and fair. ProducePay’s network, technology and financing give farmers access to an efficient market, providing financial independence. Their innovative solutions directly impact and improve the livelihoods of the stakeholders most disadvantaged by the food system. Today, ProducePay already serves hundreds of growers, distributors and receivers across the world. The global produce market relies on highly complex, global supply chains and is quickly perishable, yet produce growers lack the capital, pricing information and market access necessary to succeed. Impact is central to ProducePay’s mission. Their solutions provide flexible financing options and market data to empower historically disadvantaged farmers. Their products directly address inequities in the market due to market opacity and power structures to create information equity, income and business continuity.
tagline: Empowering growers from seed to sale

description: O ur future on this planet and as a species will be determined by our ability to understand and harness biology. Only through biotechnological research can we develop solutions for sustainable nutrition to feed a growing population and the medical advances needed to address complex and urgent health challenges. But tomorrow’s breakthroughs won’t be created in today’s labs – the pace of progress in biotech must accelerate. Reshape is building a new generation of lab equipment—and the infrastructure behind it—so that scientists and technicians can dramatically accelerate their work. They are reshaping biological research and development by harnessing the power of automation and digitalization to scale experimentation and enable cross-disciplinary collaboration globally. Simplicity is their guiding star: from robotic instruments that save countless hours to a delightfully instinctive user experience on their cloud-based platform. Biology is complex, but the tools don’t have to be. Founded in 2018 by a team with backgrounds spanning systems engineering, mechatronics, cloud infrastructure, machine learning, and biotech applications, Reshape is based in Copenhagen and operates globally.
tagline: The most impactful microbiology lab automation robotics suite empowering the bio based economy

description: R FI Ingredients is building the vertically integrated backbone of the nutrition industry, controlling every step from field to formula. The company sources, ferments and formulates certified-organic ingredients for the supplement, functional food and beverage brands shaping how people nourish themselves. Its range spans the plants consumers increasingly seek out for their health, from organic spirulina, ginger, turmeric and yerba maté to cereal grasses, fruit and vegetable powders and vegan proteins. By owning the chain from organic raw material cultivation and harvesting all the way through processing, RFI delivers the traceability, quality and consistency that finished-product brands increasingly demand. Consumers are moving decisively toward food and supplements that are natural, functional and demonstrably good for them, but much of the industry still relies on fragmented, opaque supply chains and isolated compounds that the body struggles to absorb. RFI takes a different route. Its proprietary whole-food fermentation processes transform organic raw materials with minimal alteration, retaining the highest possible nutrition and improving the bioavailability of the nutrients the body actually uses. The market for functional nutrition is expanding rapidly as prevention and healthspan move to the centre of consumer priorities, yet growth on this scale is only sustainable if it is anchored in responsible sourcing. RFI keeps organic cultivation at the core of its model, pairing that discipline with proprietary fermented ingredient lines such as FermaPro and turnkey manufacturing that lets brands bring better products to market faster. Founded in 1989 and built by specialists in organic sourcing, fermentation science and product formulation, RFI combines the discipline of an established manufacturer with the innovation of a technology partner. Its model links soil to shelf, making healthier nutrition and cleaner, organic supply chains commercially scalable at the same time.
tagline: From soil to shelf, ingredients for functional nutrition

description: T urn automation challenges into advantage with vision AI Any user—from factory operators and farmers to engineers and physicians—can create and retrain dynamic AI solutions with the Robovision AI Platform. By adding intelligence to machines, Robovision customers and partners can optimize automation processes, increase value, and accelerate innovation and time to market. Today, Robovision is trusted to power more than 1,000 robots across six continents.
tagline: Building a no-code computer vision platform to simplify AI integration for dynamic environments

description: S ource.ag, is building an AI-powered software platform that enables indoor growers to dynamically adapt their cultivation strategy, optimizing resources and ultimately supporting sustainable production of fruits and vegetables. Greenhouse agriculture is a proven solution for sustainable, local, and climate-resilient food production: it produces up to 15 times higher yields without the need for arable land and uses up to 20 times less water as compared to traditional farming methods. Today, 70% of global freshwater withdrawals are used for food production, and 46% of the planet’s habitable land is used for agriculture. With the global population growing to an estimated 10B by 2050, resource efficient farming methods need to be scaled up globally to meet the demand for healthy food in a sustainable manner. Source.ag’s cutting edge A.I. platform empowers more growers to operate more acres in more locations more efficiently, thereby accelerating the global adoption of greenhouse agriculture. The Dutch company is partnering with the world’s leading growers to help increase vegetable yields in the face of the growing energy and climate crises. With the global demand for greenhouse agriculture rising, Source will empower growers worldwide to accelerate their growth and operate facilities more efficiently. Source.ag focuses on the largest global fresh vegetable segments such as tomato and peppers, with the ambition to ultimately help all fruit and vegetable growers. At Source, a world class team of experienced engineers and plant scientists built the most advanced A.I. powered digital support system for indoor agriculture. Source has partnered with the leading growers since day one to ensure that their system addresses growers’ precise pain points. Source’s algorithms simulate plant developments to define growth strategy, support decision making and help growers execute an optimal cultivation strategy.
tagline: Feeding a healthier tomorrow with A.I. powered indoor agriculture

description: S pectacular Labs is focused on streamlining food safety testing through its flagship product, Spectacular OneTouch —a benchtop, lab-in-a-box system designed to simplify and accelerate pathogen testing. The system automates the entire process, from enrichment to generating a certificate of analysis (COA), enabling food producers to carry out testing in-house with the speed and confidence typically associated with external laboratories. By reducing reliance on third-party labs and providing rapid, accurate results within a single shift, Spectacular Labs aims to help businesses maintain safety standards while staying focused on their core operations.
tagline: An innovative platform for automated foodborne pathogen testing

description: F ounded in France, Standing Ovation is a team of researchers, engineers, and dedicated innovators advancing the frontiers of protein science. Positioned at the intersection of biotechnology and microbiology, we transform precision fermentation into a sustainable and high-performance alternative—nature-inspired and driven by innovation. In the face of climate challenges, depleting resources, and the need to feed a growing population, it is imperative to adopt a new model . At Standing Ovation, they are shaping a future where producing better aligns with preserving more . Through science and precision fermentation, they are reimagining proteins to provide a sustainable and high-performance alternative—an innovation that supports life, contributing to a food system that is in harmony with the future .
tagline: Animal-free caseins produced through precision fermentation to supply the Industry with low-impact proteins

description: S WAP make delicious, clean-label meat replacements from plants. Their first product, SWAP Filet (SWAP Chicken in the United States), is a thick, whole filet that closely replicates the taste, texture, and appearance of chicken using a short list of familiar ingredients. From preparation to performance, SWAP Filet can replace chicken on any menu, enabling chefs to recreate classic recipes for modern times. Originally founded in France in 2020, they rebranded from Umiami to SWAP in 2024 to convey how simple it is for consumers and chefs to swap protein. SWAP is currently available in Europe and Chicago, Illinois.
tagline: The world’s first plant-based whole cuts, the future of protein texturization

description: T oday we make commercial fertilizer with fossil fuels, releasing over a gigaton of CO2 equivalent emissions every year—about the same as all of the cars in the United States—along with other issues like: Global inequality, Energy cost, pollution and national security. At Switch Bioworks they engineer naturally occurring microbes to become sustainable fertilizer producing factories directly on the roots of plants. Led by Tim Schnabel, the Switch Bioworks team is made up of almost exclusively scientists and bioengineers, all focused on the engineering grand challenge of creating a sustainable fertilizer.
tagline: Building sustainable fertilizer with synthetic biology to fight climate change

description: R apidly growing interest in the gut and gut microbiome health reflects the increasing challenges society faces from chronic diseases, such as diabetes, obesity, depression and anxiety. Research increasingly demonstrates the deep link between gut and gut microbiome health and physical and mental health outcomes. One of the simplest ways to improve gut health is through increased regular fiber consumption to meet the recommended 30g of fibre per day (Source: the Lancet ). However, many people struggle to reach their daily fiber recommendation. Fewer than 1 in 10 people in the UK eats the recommended amount of daily fiber (Source: WHO ). The Gut Stuff aims to ensure that everyone has access to the food and knowledge to support their gut health – at price points that are accessible to all. The Gut Stuff has made it its mission to educate people of all ages and backgrounds about the importance of a healthy gut and gut microbiome. The company complements its educational website and trainings with accessible, nutritious products that consumers can easily incorporate into their daily routines. Beginning with a fiber bar, The Gut Stuff is building a suite of gut-loving products. With the help of their scientific advisors, the team will continue to support their community in understanding and accessing products and practices to support their guts.
tagline: Challenging the food status quo with plant-based alternatives

description: T ractor Junction is transforming access to agricultural mechanization in rural India through a fully digital marketplace for tractors, harvesters, implements, and farm tools. By curating transparent equipment listings, detailed technical specs, peer reviews, and real-time price comparisons, the platform empowers farmers to make data-driven decisions when purchasing or selling machinery. Beyond its core marketplace, Tractor Junction integrates financial services including loans and insurance to reduce the barriers to equipment ownership and maintenance. The company also delivers educational content, multilingual support, and decision-support tools to foster deeper engagement with smallholder farmers. With this integrated ecosystem, Tractor Junction is not just a transaction platform: it’s building a scalable infrastructure for rural mechanization, increasing productivity, lowering entry costs, and modernizing how India’s farming communities invest in and manage their machinery.
tagline: Platform connecting Indian farmers with tractors and farm equipment

description: U nlocked Labs is introducing a new class of probiotics aimed at transforming the way microbial supplements are understood and used. Unlike most products that offer multi-strain blends for general gut health, Unlocked focuses on single-strain probiotics specifically designed to perform targeted functions. With the individual in mind, they begin by identifying a biological compound that should be regulated or maintained at healthy levels. Through extensive literature reviews and scientific research, they select a probiotic strain with the potential to break down that compound. Their scientists then enhance the strain’s effectiveness through a proprietary process that activates and amplifies its degradative capabilities. The result is a shelf-stable probiotic formulation that activates only when it reaches the intestine, ensuring optimal performance where it’s needed most.
tagline: Next generation probiotics

description: B y 2050, our planet will need to feed 10 billion people. v2food was formed in 2019 to meet this challenge by developing innovative new forms of plant-based protein. Products made to be embraced by consumers of all kinds, created in association with the CSIRO and the Australian agricultural and food industries. v2food has since grown to become Australia’s leading plant-based protein brand. Its products can be found in supermarkets, cafes and restaurants and homes across the country. This makes v2food an important part of a new $6bn+ industry. In 2024, v2food successfully completed the purchase of two leading online ready-made meal subscription brands, MACROS and Soulara. This extends its reach into thousands of Australians homes via a direct to consumer platform and provides new ways for market testing and consumer education. Soulara was founded to grow the plant-based movement by making it convenient and simple to follow a plant-based diet. Every week Soulara ships tens of thousands of meals to vegans, vegetarians and flexitarians Australia-wide. All chef-made from high quality local produce and delivered fresh. MACROS delivers dietitian-designed meals Australia-wide and was started in 2019 as a way for the fitness-focused to support their training. It soon discovered a wider market of busy people looking for a way to cook less without compromising healthiness. MACROS meals are chef-made, free from further added preservatives or additives, sodium and sugar controlled and made to support a balanced diet with lean protein, complex carbs and good fats.
tagline: Plant-based meat that's good for you and for the planet

description: V ivent Biosignals turns plant intelligence into business intelligence for farmers, ag input companies, agronomists, and food processors. Using advanced electrophysiology sensors and proprietary AI, they capture biological signals directly from plants and translate them into real-time actionable insights. These signals reveal how plants respond to stress, nutrition, light, and environmental changes—often days before visible symptoms appear. Their intuitive platform delivers 24/7 crop health insights, including water status, nutrient deficiencies, and early warnings for insect or fungal stress. They also track the impact of inputs like biostimulants and advanced fertilisers, helping users assess effectiveness and adjust practices early. Early diagnosis means timely action, higher yields, optimized use of water and fertilizers, and support for sustainable crop treatments. Used in greenhouses, open fields, and R&D across Europe and beyond, Vivent’s wearable plant sensors and AI-powered analytics drive the shift to predictive, plant-driven agriculture. Backed by the world’s largest database of plant biosignals, they empower smarter decisions that boost productivity and reduce input waste. When you tap into the intelligence of plants, you unlock the full potential of your fields.
tagline: Providing plant health intelligence in real-time

description: I mproved dietary choices should be a seamless part of life, not a compromise. Current food solutions often rely on synthetic methods and reformulated recipes, leading to consumer uncertainty and dissatisfaction. Zya shifts the narrative from synthetic interventions to natural, science-driven transformations. By harnessing the inherent capability of enzymes, we empower the consumer to make better choices, whilst championing their taste preferences. The market is saturated with ‘better-for-you’ options that fall short on flavor and rely heavily on fake ingredient substitutions. This creates a dilemma where more nutritious choices are often less appealing in both form and taste, with conflicting information about what’s really good for us. The result? ‘Better-for-you’ products that fails to engage and benefit the wider public. Enzymes are nature’s powerful change agents. Their unique ability to catalyze reactions can be harnessed not just in food production, but at the point of digestion. At Zya, they harness these micro enzymes to create macro impacts. By introducing specific enzyme ingredients into food products, they can transform nutritional profiles while preserving taste.
tagline: Using the power of enzymes to transform how our bodies use food
